race.description: Snap Printing Wollongong C,G&E Mdn Hcp
race.comment: WAR BANNER (6) is a Waterhouse/Bott-trained debutant by Snitzel from the Group 2 Rubiton winner Heatherly. Has won his last three trials in good style, the two most recent in October. Fully wound up to make a successful start to his career. SACRED VOW (7) was in the market on debut recently over 1100m at Hawkesbury but couldn't quicken from back in the field and missed the placings. Worth another chance on this bigger track over an extra 100m. BRUTAL ADVANCE (2) put in a sequence of three seconds in a row, the two most recent here at this trip, before a mediocre effort at Wyong last Thursday. Nine-time placegetter who should go in all the exotics. CATHEDRAL COVE (10) returns from a 40-week spell. Has had plenty of chances in his 14-start career. Did win a recent Hawkesbury trial so he might be in for a decent campaign. MY STAR (8) is a lightweight chance off a 38-day let-up.
